## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes (coverage stays above the floor set in `pyproject.toml`)
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `black --check .` and `mypy` are clean
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the new behaviour or bug fix
- [ ] `README.md` updated if a command-line option or output format changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or local files (`word_history.json`, `.cache/`) committed
